Frontend 390×844: landing shows logo + 7 services; login has 'Esqueci minha senha' testID forgot-password-link → Recuperar senha screen renders; admin login→/dashboard shows 'Trabalhando hoje: Jackson, Wendel' R$405 11 agendamentos 9 concluídos 12 na fila 11 mensalistas 1 pagto pendente; Config hub ALL 13 chips present (tab-branding, tab-shop, tab-services, tab-plan, tab-team, tab-payments, tab-pix, tab-general, tab-clients, tab-resets, tab-finance, tab-reports, tab-audit); tab-resets shows pending codes with 'Enviar pelo WhatsApp'; tab-audit lists plan.update/general.update/barber.account.reset with user+timestamp+before/after; barber jackson@wendelcortes.com login shows ONLY tabs Painel/Agenda/Fila/Perfil (no Barbeiros/Config/Mensal), 'Meu Painel', 'Minha agenda' with date tabs (no barber filter chip), 'Fila do Jackson · 1 barbeiros'. Regression: 72/77 of combined suite pass; 5 failures are PRE-EXISTING cross-run data accumulation (not caused by this iteration) — see action_items. No deprecated expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).
action_items: (pre-existing, NOT caused by iteration 5) test_barbers.py has 4 shared-DB-state failures: TestPerBarberConflict.test_different_barbers_same_time_both_ok (same slot keeps accumulating prior TEST appointments → 409 on second booking); TestMensal.test_mensal_reserved_at_booking_consumed_on_concluido (carlos's monthly cuts were fully consumed by earlier test runs → 400 'cortes do ciclo atual'); TestQueuePerBarber.test_admin_call_start_complete_calls_next_same_barber (expects ≥2 waiting entries, state leftover); TestAnyAutoPick.test_any_booking_picks_a_barber (same slot already booked). Mitigation: use uuid-based unique future dates per test or add a cleanup fixture that deletes TEST_* data at session start.

(pre-existing) test_security.py::TestSeedProtection.test_seed_admin_idempotent asserts len(services)==7 but DB now has 11 due to accumulated TEST_svc created across runs — relax assertion to `>=7` or filter out TEST_ prefix.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_config.py cleanly separated and injected via make_config_router(ctx) — good modular pattern.

pix.py build_pix_payload builds a correct EMV QRCPS-MPM payload (CRC16-CCITT over payload[:-4] matches), including proper TLV encoding of amount (TLV 54) and txid (TLV 62→05). Verified end-to-end with real appointment response.

/auth/forgot lowercases the email before insert — tests must lower() before matching the stored record. Admin GET /admin/password-resets intentionally returns the plain code so the founder can relay via WhatsApp (expected behaviour per PRD).
DELETE /services/{sid} archives (sets archived:true, active:false) when appointments exist and fully deletes otherwise — behaviour matches spec and preserves history.
require_staff + barber_scope correctly limits barber role to their own appointments/queue and prevents cross-barber confirmations (403). /appointments as client → 403; /admin/audit as client → 403.

Backend has NO deprecated expo packages (backend is Python); frontend package.json uses current expo-notifications/expo-image/expo-linear-gradient — no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch references detected in backend or admin_config imports.
